posts.title: Tetrasquares: extending The New Tetris on N64
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: I like building squares more than clearing lines. A browser experiment with the N64 game's square mechanic, interlock bonuses, and 6x6 and 8x8 targets.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Affina and the quadratics
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Quadratic homework moonlights as an affine cipher in HSCTF 2020's Affina and the Quadratics. Its coefficients give the game away.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Chonky E
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: HSCTF 2020's Chonky E skimps on the private exponent: Boneh-Durfee cracks RSA, and shared primes take Schmidt-Samoa down with it.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Extremely Complex Challenge
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: SageMath has a modest workload in HSCTF 2020's Extremely Complex Challenge: recover an elliptic-curve parameter, then solve a decidedly small discrete log.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Morbid
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Nine symbols, 9! keys, one brute-force budget: decode Morbit's Morse pairs in HSCTF 2020's Morbid.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Randomization 1
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: HSCTF 2020's Randomization 1 brings 8 bits of LCG state to a guessing game. Ghidra helps put all ten predictions on the answer sheet.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Randomization 2
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: The exposed 64-bit LCG state in HSCTF 2020's Randomization 2 does the fortune-telling for us. Python just needs to remember to overflow.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Smol E
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: HSCTF 2020's Smol E pads RSA messages on a budget. Coppersmith finds the short-pad difference; Franklin-Reiter finishes the decryption.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - Unexpected
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Three RSA moduli borrow each other's primes in HSCTF 2020's Unexpected. Pairwise GCDs collect the debt and let us decrypt.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - XORed
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: XOR's cancellation policy does the work in HSCTF 2020's XORed: recover the message without recovering each individual key first.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Crypto - XKCD 2247 v2
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Invert a 100-by-100 Hill cipher key modulo 26 in HSCTF 2020's XKCD 2247 v2. Bring SageMath, leave the graph paper.

posts.title: HSCTF 2020 Misc - N95
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: QR code surgery in HSCTF 2020's N-95: rebuild the grid, recover the mask pattern and brute-force missing bits. The scanner needs backup.

posts.title: BATPWN 2020 Crypto - Cryptographer
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: BATPWN 2020's Cryptographer spells its timestamp XOR key in ASCII zeroes and ones. Each key byte has just two career options.

posts.title: BATPWN 2020 Crypto: M-ick Maybe
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Proofreading is cryptanalysis in BATPWN 2020's M-ick Maybe: solve a substitution cipher, then diff it against Moby Dick for stowaway characters.

posts.title: BATPWN 2020 Crypto - Prefixes
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Go's shifts and XORs get a reverse gear in BATPWN 2020's Prefixes: test all 256 byte values and reconstruct the input one character at a time.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - December
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Four weak DES keys audition for NahamCon 2020's December. OFB decryption gives one the part.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - Docxor
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: ZIP magic bytes earn their wizard hat in NahamCon 2020's Docxor: recover a four-byte XOR key from the header and restore the document.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - Homecooked
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: NahamCon 2020's Homecooked leaves its prime-palindrome XOR decoder simmering in trial division. gmpy2's primality test cuts the cooking time.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - Oo la la
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RSA's primes are a little too neighborly in NahamCon 2020's Ooo-la-la. Alpertron factors the modulus so decryption can proceed.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - Raspberry
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: NahamCon 2020's Raspberry packs RSA with snack-sized primes. Factor them, compute the totient and unwrap the ciphertext.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - Twinning
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: A gap of two is poor personal space for RSA primes: a square root factors the modulus in NahamCon 2020's Twinning and unlocks the PIN.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - Unvreakable Vase
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Base64 lost its uppercase letters in NahamCon 2020's Unvreakable Vase. A four-character brute-force loop joins the case-sensitive repair crew.

posts.title: Nahamcon 2020 Crypto - elsa4
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: A timestamp is the LC4 seed suspect in NahamCon 2020's elsa4. The investigation is still frozen at nonce handling, which remains unresolved.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - 01
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RACTF 2020's 01 swaps the alphabet and misplaces the spaces. quipqiup solves the monoalphabetic substitution; word spacing still needs a human.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - 02
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: The alphabet keeps changing shifts in RACTF 2020's 02. Identify Vigenere and let dCode fish out the key.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - 03
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Letter frequencies rat out a transposition in RACTF 2020's 03. The plaintext took a five-rail fence detour.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - 04
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RACTF 2020's 04 shuffles columns but leaves English letter frequencies on the nametag. A visual solver undoes the columnar transposition.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - 05
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RACTF 2020's 05 forgot to disguise its statistics. They point to Bifid; CryptoCrack handles the decryption.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - 06
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Periodic Gromark needs a numeric primer; RACTF 2020's 06 packed one for us. CryptoCrack takes it from there.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - B007L36 CRYP70 A641N
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RACTF 2020's B007L36 CRYP70 A641N puts on Base64 camouflage. Underneath, repeating-key addition lets known plaintext recover the key by subtraction.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - BOO7l3G CRYP70
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: The random four-number blocks in RACTF 2020's BOO7l3G CRYP70 keep changing outfits but not their sums. Addition recovers the encoded characters.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - Its as easy as access=0000
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Promote yourself by XOR in RACTF 2020's It's as easy as access=0000: flip AES-CBC IV bits to edit a guest token into admin credentials.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - Mysterious Masquerading Message
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RACTF 2020's Mysterious Masquerading Message wears an SSH private-key costume. Decode its clues to find the key and IV for AES-CBC decryption.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - Really Secret Algorithm
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: The walrus operator isn't a vault. RACTF 2020's Really Secret Algorithm hides RSA primes behind reversible running XOR and Base85.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - Really Simple Algorithm
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RACTF 2020's Really Simple Algorithm ships RSA with p and q included. Compute the private exponent and decrypt; the factoring department has the day off.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - Really Small Algorithm
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: A tiny RSA prime gives trial division a job in RACTF 2020's Really Small Algorithm. Find the factor, then decrypt with modular arithmetic.

posts.title: RACTF 2020 Crypto - Really Speedy Algirithm
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RACTF 2020's Really Speedy Algorithm puts RSA on a shot clock: parse the prompts and script the missing parameters for 100 timed questions.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - 12 Shades of Redpwn
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: redpwnCTF 2020's 12 Shades of Redpwn makes the color wheel do arithmetic. Map hues to base-12 digits and convert the result to text.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - 4k-rsa
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: A large RSA modulus made of smaller primes is factorization's bulk discount in redpwnCTF 2020's 4k-rsa. Recover the factors and decryption exponent.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - Alien Transmissions v2
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Even aliens have word-spacing habits. Frequency analysis recovers a combined XOR key in redpwnCTF 2020's Alien Transmissions v2; Z3 splits it in two.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - base646464
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: redpwnCTF 2020's base646464 applies Base64 25 times. A Python decode loop respectfully declines to call that encryption.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - Itsy Bitsy
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Leading bits in this random XOR keystream insist on being 1. Their predictable habits expose the plaintext in redpwnCTF 2020's Itsy Bitsy.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - primimity
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Three RSA primes share a postcode in redpwnCTF 2020's primimity. Search near the modulus's cube root to find the factors.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - Pseudo-key
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: A Vigenere key encrypts itself in redpwnCTF 2020's Pseudo-key, leaving 2,048 candidates. Self-care would have involved a different key.

posts.title: Redpwn 2020 Crypto - worst_pw_manager
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Eight Python references in a trench coat pose as an RC4 key in redpwnCTF 2020's worst-pw-manager. Decode filenames, then brute-force the repeated key byte.

posts.title: rgbCTF 2020 Crypto - Adequate Encryption Standard
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: rgbCTF 2020's Adequate Encryption Standard has a custom cipher whose key schedule gets stuck on 0 or 1. Reverse the rounds and exploit the rut.

posts.title: rgbCTF 2020 Crypto - N-AES
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: rgbCTF 2020's N-AES has more layers than entropy: brute-force a fixed one-byte seed to undo 128 AES layers, minding Python's int-versus-bytes seed trap.

posts.title: 0CTF/TCTF 2020 Crypto - babyring
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: 0CTF/TCTF 2020's babyring makes RC4 run in circles. Reduce the ring check to XOR equations and let SageMath choose RSA inputs that close the loop.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - Analyze Me
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: zh3r0 CTF 2020's Analyze Me can't pick a base. Decode the mixed-base chunks, then undo XOR and repeated byte substitutions in the second act.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - Double Fish
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: zh3r0 CTF 2020's Double Fish pairs Deadfish with Blowfish-CBC and an XOR-masked key. A stray escape sequence makes this fishing trip harder.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - Hastads Message
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: RSA repeats itself but forgets to introduce e in zh3r0 CTF 2020's Hastad's Message. Try exponents with CRT and integer roots for the broadcast attack.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - Mix
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: zh3r0 CTF 2020's Mix serves Base65536 with keyboard-shift clues and a Spoon esolang finish. Decoding comes with cutlery.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - RSA warmup
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: SymPy finds the small prime that skipped leg day in zh3r0 CTF 2020's RSA Warmup. Factor the modulus, then decrypt with the recovered key.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - Uncipher Me
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: zh3r0 CTF 2020's Uncipher Me sends us on an encoded-key scavenger hunt. The ROT47-derived key opens the Fernet token; the other keys are busywork.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - We are related
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Chosen suffixes give RSA messages a family resemblance in zh3r0 CTF 2020's We Are Related. Franklin-Reiter recovers the shared plaintext.

posts.title: zh3r0 2020 Crypto - gboad maddy
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Gboard's alternate symbols get promoted to ciphertext in zh3r0 CTF 2020's gboad maddy. Map them to letters, apply ROT13 and infer the missing characters.

posts.title: Google CTF 2021 Crypto - Pythia
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Google CTF 2021's Pythia has commitment issues: AES-GCM key multicollisions turn a partitioning oracle into a short-password recovery tool.

posts.title: Cyber Apocalypse HTB 2022 Crypto - Memory Acceleration
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: HTB Cyber Apocalypse 2022's Memory Acceleration puts Z3 on a diet: brute-force part of a custom proof-of-work hash and model the smaller remainder.

posts.title: Google CTF 2022 Crypto - Maybe Someday
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: Google CTF 2022 cryptography writeup maybe someday paillier cryptosystem homomorphic padding oracle

posts.title: SDCTF 2022 Crypto - Tasty Crypto Roll
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: SDCTF 2022's Tasty Crypto Roll seasons its key with a PID. Recover it, undo bit shuffling and let Z3 solve the ECB substitution constraints.

posts.title: ACSC qualifiers 2023 Crypto - SusCipher
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: ACSC 2023's SusCipher gets cross-examined by Z3: 48 single-bit plaintexts give a model enough evidence to recover the three-round block cipher's key.

posts.title: Nullcon HackIM 2023 Crypto - Curvy Decryptor
posts.author: deuterium
posts.description: CTF writeup: Nullcon HackIM 2023's Curvy Decryptor admits off-curve guests. Shift EC points past the decryption filter, then recover the private key with invalid curves and CRT.
